properties.description: Inception (2010), directed by Christopher Nolan and starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Elliot Page, is a science-fiction action thriller that centers on a team of specialists who invade dreams to extract or implant ideas. Combining heist mechanics with layered, nested dream sequences, the film blends spectacle and intimate drama as the team confronts psychological sabotage tied to the leader's tragic past. Themes of guilt, memory, identity and the malleability of reality are explored through tense set pieces and a deliberately ambiguous ending, supported by a moody visual palette and an urgent score.

properties.description: The Crack: Inception (2019), directed by José Luis Garci and starring Carlos Santos, Miguel Ángel Muñoz and Luisa Gavasa, is a black-and-white Spanish crime drama and prequel in a trilogy about private detective Germán Areta. The plot follows Areta as he leaves the police force to work as a private investigator in late-Francoist Spain and plunges into a dangerous inquiry into an apparent suicide. The film operates as a deliberate, literary noir homage with themes of moral ambiguity, corruption and personal obsession, and it evokes a melancholic, tense emotional register throughout.

short_descriptions.value: A former policeman becomes a private detective in late Francoist Spain and pursues a risky investigation into an apparent suicide.

Un ex policía se convierte en detective privado en la España del final del franquismo y investiga arriesgadamente un aparente suicidio.
Un ancien policier devient détective privé dans l'Espagne de la fin du franquisme et mène une enquête risquée sur un suicide apparent.

properties.description: DeInception is a 2026 Australian documentary directed by John Angheli, who also appears in the film alongside Hayley Beveridge and Tania Wieclaw. Following a near-fatal car accident, Angheli sets out on a 40-day vision quest in the Tasmanian wilderness to investigate the nature of happiness and its role in personal and social life. The film combines solitude, fasting, and conversations with leading thinkers to examine meaning, mortality, and modern discontent in a reflective, philosophical register.

short_descriptions.value: A man embarks on a wilderness vision quest to explore the nature of happiness and modern discontent.

Un homme part en quête visionnaire dans la nature pour explorer la bonheur et le mal-être moderne.

properties.description: Insha Allah - An inception at closure (2019) is a drama directed by S.P.P. Bhaskaran and featuring Pagavathi Ammal, Menaga, Mohan, and Nambirajan. Told in Tamil, the film offers a series of domestic vignettes that reveal the lived realities of Muslim blue-collar workers, emphasizing quiet moments over dramatic plot turns. Its focus on family, faith, and labor situates it within social realist traditions, and its restrained, empathetic tone aims to highlight dignity amid economic strain. The result is a contemplative portrait that invites reflection on community and identity.

short_descriptions.value: An intimate, empathetic portrait of Muslim blue-collar families navigating work, faith, and domestic pressures in daily life.
Ein eindringliches Porträt muslimischer Arbeiterfamilien, die Arbeit, Glauben und häusliche Belastungen im Alltag meistern.
Retrato íntimo y empático de familias musulmanas de clase obrera que afrontan trabajo, fe y tensiones domésticas en su día a día.
Portrait intime et empathique de familles musulmanes ouvrières confrontées au travail, à la foi et aux tensions domestiques du quotidien.
